title: Esther Clark (Forbes contributor, Drucker Challenge winner) — 'You're not stuck in traffic. You are traffic'
summary: Author and Forbes contributor Esther Clark — Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts, Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Marketing, Drucker Challenge Entrepreneur/Manager winner — reads Incorruptible on Steve Blank's recommendation and pulls one line that stayed with her: a reminder that we all play a role in shaping the organizations we want to see.
blockquote: Just finished reading 'Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad and How Great Companies Stay Great' by Eric Ries, recommended to me by Steve Blank. … One line that stayed with me: 'You're not stuck in traffic. You are traffic.'
attribution_title: Author · Global Head of Communications · MBA FRSA FCIM · Drucker Laureate · Forbes contributor
